dedupe_keys.name: monthly public transport patronage by mode

description: Monthly public transport patronage by mode is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. Monthly total patronage for metropolitan and regional train, metropolitan and regional bus, tram and regional coach services in Victoria, to allow users to analyse trends in patronage by mode. Patronage is a count of patron boardings onto services, with the exclusion of train transfers that do not involve a change in direction. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are boarding, bus, coach, patronage, public transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-08-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
